artboards.title: Before lock — in progress, attest disabled

annotations.text: Status strip (top bar) is the shared pattern for every hub-linked screen: state chip = button back to the hub · hub's evidence line · Attest on the right. Attest never overrides needs-attention / waiting.

Decisions 25 Aug: lock via button (this is slice H3 — importState + activate on click, not on save) · old Agency tab on /admin Configuration is removed · address state is separate from the jurisdiction state.
